title: Djoser
summary: King listed in CFAH-7B Table 7 (Egypt Dynasties 3–4 (Memphis)).
description: Ruler of Egypt Dynasties 3–4 (Memphis). Person record added by the CFAH pass from the per-king rows of the OSF preprint CFAH-7B (Table 7, "Integrated Dates for Dynasties 3 & 4"); its dates are display only.

sorting_basis.note: No tier gives a birth year.

standby.note: Standby placement only. Chronological Framework of Ancient History prints this BC/AD year on the reign entry (Start Co-Rex: 2011/2010; Start Sole-rex: 2001; End Sole-rex: 1982; Death or Deposition: 1982). It is not a sort year. No Anno Mundi, regnal length, or Julian Period figure was converted to obtain it.
